---
title: "12 — Exploratory PSU-bootstrap subgroup AUROC uncertainty"
output: html_notebook
---

**Measures:** sensitivity of the observed 2025 AI/AN-minus-comparison AUROC gap to stratified resampling of primary sampling units (PSUs), keeping model predictions fixed. **Important:** these are approximate conditional intervals, not guaranteed design-consistent BRFSS estimates or uncertainty from model development.

## Setup

Loads the unchanged input settings, shared model functions, and the persistent run
increment. The output suffix identifies this run.

```{r setup}
# Set the project root, then load R code from the shared R Notebooks.

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Project-root discovery
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Search upward for the project marker so notebook paths do not depend on a particular
# subfolder.
find_project_root <- function(start = getwd()) {
    current <- normalizePath(start, mustWork = TRUE)
    # Walk toward the filesystem root until the project marker is found.
    repeat {
        if (file.exists(file.path(current, "FMD_Project.Rproj"))) {
            return(current)
        }
        # Move up one directory; an unchanged parent marks the filesystem root.
        parent <- dirname(current)
        if (identical(parent, current)) {
            stop("Open FMD_Project.Rproj in RStudio first")
        }
        current <- parent
    }
}


# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Notebook execution root
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Resolve the project before loading modules; configure subsequent knitr chunks to use
# that root.
project_root <- find_project_root()
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = project_root)


# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Shared-module loader
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Extract R chunks in source order and evaluate them in the caller environment.
# This lightweight loader does not process chunk options such as eval = FALSE.
load_module <- function(name) {
    path <- file.path(project_root, "R", paste0(name, ".Rmd"))
    text <- readLines(path, warn = FALSE)
    starts <- which(startsWith(text, "```{r"))
    ends <- which(trimws(text) == "```")
    blocks <- lapply(starts, function(start) {
        # Use the next standalone closing fence for this R chunk.
        finish <- ends[ends > start][1]
        if (is.na(finish) || finish <= start + 1L) {
            stop("Missing code or closing fence in ", path)
        }
        paste(text[(start + 1L):(finish - 1L)], collapse = "\n")
    })
    eval(parse(text = paste(blocks, collapse = "\n\n")), envir = parent.frame())
    invisible(TRUE)
}


# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Shared settings and utilities
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Load configuration before helpers, retaining the existing presentation palette module.
load_module("config")
load_module("run_manager")
load_module("helpers")
load_module("plot_palette")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Existing-run attachment
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Attach to an allocated run rather than incrementing the counter in this stage.
run_context <- attach_run()
cat("[RUN] Current increment:", run_context$id, "\n")
```



## Resample design clusters and estimate subgroup AUROC

Resamples entire PSUs within the source strata and uses the same resample for both
groups. Samples with singleton PSUs cannot contribute the full variance and are held
fixed; the method requires independent validation for a publication-quality claim.

```{r psu-bootstrap}
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Fixed-model cluster resampling
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Use a common within-stratum PSU draw for both populations in each replicate.
# Hold predictions fixed and interpret percentile intervals as exploratory
# approximations.

# Bootstrap fixed 2025 predictions at the survey PSU level, not individual rows.
# This is an APPROXIMATE stratified-cluster resampling sensitivity analysis.
# It does not refit the model and does not replace the CDC design-based variance method.
scored <- load_run_rds("checkpoints", "07_scored_2025")
selected <- load_run_rds("models", "05_frozen_selection")
if (anyNA(scored[, .(YEAR, STATE, STRAT, PSU, RAW_WEIGHT)])) {
    stop("Survey design identifiers cannot be missing for the PSU bootstrap")
}
scored[, stratum_key := paste(YEAR, STATE, STRAT, sep = "_")]
scored[, psu_key := paste(YEAR, STATE, STRAT, PSU, sep = "_")]

# Build strata from the complete weighted 2025 survey before extracting subgroups.
psu_table <- unique(scored[, .(stratum_key, psu_key)])
psu_table[, psu_index := seq_len(.N)]
strata_indices <- split(psu_table$psu_index, psu_table$stratum_key)
scored[, psu_index := psu_table$psu_index[match(psu_key, psu_table$psu_key)]]
if (anyNA(scored$psu_index)) {
    stop("Could not map every observation to its original survey PSU")
}
primary <- scored[cohort %in% primary_groups & valid_outcome(FMD)]
if (!all(primary_groups %in% unique(primary$cohort))) {
    stop("Both comparison groups are required for the AUROC bootstrap")
}

# Exactly the same PSU resample supplies BOTH groups in each replicate,
# preserving covariance in the AUROC difference.
replicates <- vector("list", psu_bootstrap_replicates)

# Set the random seed before stochastic operations so the same inputs can reproduce this
# sampling sequence.
set.seed(seed + 1205L)

# Iterate through the configured analysis items in the original execution order.
for (replicate in seq_len(psu_bootstrap_replicates)) {
    # Start all PSU multiplicities at zero before drawing within each stratum.
    counts <- integer(nrow(psu_table))
    for (indices in strata_indices) {
        if (length(indices) == 1L) {
            # Hold singleton strata fixed; this resampling cannot estimate their
            # variability.
            counts[indices] <- 1L
        } else {
            draws <- sample.int(
                length(indices),
                size = length(indices),
                replace = TRUE
            )
            counts[indices] <- tabulate(draws, nbins = length(indices))
        }
    }

    # A PSU absent from a replicate receives zero weight; no rows are imputed.
    multiplied_weights <- primary$RAW_WEIGHT * counts[primary$psu_index]
    ai_index <- primary$cohort == primary_groups[1]
    other_index <- primary$cohort == primary_groups[2]
    auc_ai <- weighted_auc(
        primary$FMD[ai_index],
        primary$selected_probability[ai_index],
        multiplied_weights[ai_index]
    )
    auc_other <- weighted_auc(
        primary$FMD[other_index],
        primary$selected_probability[other_index],
        multiplied_weights[other_index]
    )
    replicates[[replicate]] <- data.frame(
        replicate = replicate,
        auc_ai_an = auc_ai,
        auc_other_single_race = auc_other,
        auc_gap = auc_ai - auc_other
    )
    if (replicate %% 25L == 0L) {
        cat("[BOOTSTRAP] Finished", replicate, "PSU replicates\n")
    }
}
replicate_table <- data.table::rbindlist(replicates)

# Save this result under the attached run ID so it remains linked to the current
# analysis.
save_table(replicate_table, "12_psu_bootstrap_auc_replicates")

# Calculate the point estimate from the unresampled, weighted 2025 observations.
base_ai <- primary[cohort == primary_groups[1]]
base_other <- primary[cohort == primary_groups[2]]
point_ai <- weighted_auc(
    base_ai$FMD, base_ai$selected_probability, base_ai$RAW_WEIGHT
)
point_other <- weighted_auc(
    base_other$FMD, base_other$selected_probability, base_other$RAW_WEIGHT
)
point <- c(point_ai, point_other, point_ai - point_other)
metric_columns <- c("auc_ai_an", "auc_other_single_race", "auc_gap")
summary_rows <- lapply(seq_along(metric_columns), function(index) {
    values <- replicate_table[[metric_columns[index]]]
    good <- values[is.finite(values)]
    if (length(good) < 30L) {
        stop("Too few valid PSU bootstrap replicates for ", metric_columns[index])
    }
    # Use finite replicates for the approximate 95% percentile interval.
    interval <- stats::quantile(good, c(0.025, 0.975), names = FALSE)
    data.frame(
        metric = metric_columns[index],
        point_estimate = point[index],
        bootstrap_replicates = length(good),
        ci_lower = interval[1],
        ci_upper = interval[2],
        method = "approximate fixed-model stratified PSU resampling"
    )
})
intervals <- data.table::rbindlist(summary_rows)

# Save this result under the attached run ID so it remains linked to the current
# analysis.
save_table(intervals, "12_psu_bootstrap_auc_intervals")
print(intervals)
cat("Interpretation: exploratory PSU-resampling intervals, not a definitive CDC design-based inference.\n")
```


## Visualize AUROC-gap resampling uncertainty

Displays the distribution across replicate samples and explicitly marks zero and the
original observed gap. The histogram appears in the notebook as well as being saved.

```{r show-bootstrap}
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# AUROC-gap resampling distribution
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Display the approximate resampling distribution alongside zero and the observed gap.
# The resampling excludes uncertainty from fitting and selecting the classifier.

# Show the resampled distribution alongside the original point estimate.

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Visualization
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------


# Build the chart using the existing palette and theme; retain the original scales and
# labels.
plot <- ggplot2::ggplot(
    replicate_table,
    ggplot2::aes(x = auc_gap)
) +
    ggplot2::geom_histogram(bins = 24, fill = atg_palette[["rose"]], color = "white") +
    ggplot2::geom_vline(
        xintercept = 0,
        linetype = "dashed",
        color = atg_palette[["burgundy"]]
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_vline(xintercept = point[3], color = atg_palette[["evergreen"]]) +
    atg_theme() +
    ggplot2::labs(
        title = "Approximate PSU-bootstrap distribution of the 2025 AUROC gap",
        subtitle = paste("AI/AN alone minus other single-race |", selected$chosen_family),
        x = "Weighted AUROC difference",
        y = "Resampling replicates",
        caption = "Fixed predictions; within-stratum PSU resampling. Exploratory approximation, not CDC replicate weights."
    )
show_and_save(plot, "12_psu_bootstrap_auc_gap", 9, 5)
```
```{r}
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Bootstrap summary for plotting
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Compute an approximate percentile interval from the bootstrap replicates.
ci <- stats::quantile(
    replicate_table$auc_gap,
    probs = c(0.025, 0.975),
    na.rm = TRUE
)

# Keep the observed point estimate explicit.
observed_gap <- point[3]

# Optional descriptive values for annotation.
bootstrap_mean <- mean(replicate_table$auc_gap, na.rm = TRUE)

subtitle_text <- paste0(
    "AI/AN alone minus other single-race | ",
    selected$chosen_family,
    " | observed gap = ",
    sprintf("%+.1f pp", 100 * observed_gap),
    " | approx. 95% bootstrap interval = ",
    sprintf("%+.1f pp", 100 * ci[1]),
    " to ",
    sprintf("%+.1f pp", 100 * ci[2])
)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Visualization
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

plot <- ggplot2::ggplot(
    replicate_table,
    ggplot2::aes(x = auc_gap)
) +
    # Shade the central 95% bootstrap interval first so it sits behind the bars.
    ggplot2::annotate(
        "rect",
        xmin = ci[1],
        xmax = ci[2],
        ymin = -Inf,
        ymax = Inf,
        alpha = 0.10,
        fill = atg_palette[["evergreen"]]
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_histogram(
        binwidth = 0.005,
        boundary = 0,
        fill = atg_palette[["turquoise"]],
        color = "white",
        linewidth = 0.3
    ) +
    # Zero line: no subgroup difference.
    ggplot2::geom_vline(
        xintercept = 0,
        linetype = "dashed",
        color = atg_palette[["burgundy"]],
        linewidth = 0.8
    ) +
    # Observed point estimate.
    ggplot2::geom_vline(
        xintercept = observed_gap,
        color = atg_palette[["evergreen"]],
        linewidth = 1
    ) +
    # Optional CI boundary lines.
    ggplot2::geom_vline(
        xintercept = ci,
        linetype = "dotted",
        color = atg_palette[["evergreen"]],
        linewidth = 0.7
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(
        labels = function(values) sprintf("%+.1f pp", 100 * values)
    ) +
    atg_theme() +
    ggplot2::labs(
        title = "Approximate PSU-bootstrap distribution of the 2025 AUROC gap",
        subtitle = subtitle_text,
        x = "Weighted AUROC difference (AI/AN minus comparison, percentage points)",
        y = "Bootstrap replicates",
        caption = paste(
            "Shaded band = central 95% bootstrap interval.",
            "Green line = observed AUROC gap.",
            "Dashed burgundy line = no subgroup difference."
        )
    )

show_and_save(plot, "12_psu_bootstrap_auc_gap_enhanced", 9, 5)
```
```{r}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Publication-style 2025 AUROC gap interval plot
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Compare the selected model's weighted AUROC between
# AI/AN-alone and other identified single-race adults.
#
# Negative differences indicate lower AI/AN AUROC.
# Confidence intervals are approximate percentile intervals
# from the existing within-stratum PSU bootstrap.

# Retain finite bootstrap replicates.
bootstrap_values <- replicate_table$auc_gap
bootstrap_values <- bootstrap_values[
    is.finite(bootstrap_values)
]

stopifnot(
    length(bootstrap_values) >= 50L,
    is.finite(point[3])
)

# Calculate the approximate 95% bootstrap interval.
ci <- stats::quantile(
    bootstrap_values,
    probs = c(0.025, 0.975),
    names = FALSE
)

# Convert AUROC differences to percentage-point units.
gap_summary <- data.table::data.table(
    estimate_pp = 100 * as.numeric(point[3]),
    ci_l_pp = 100 * ci[1],
    ci_u_pp = 100 * ci[2],
    bootstrap_replicates = length(bootstrap_values)
)

# Prepare exact labels from the calculated results.
estimate_label <- sprintf(
    "%+.2f pp",
    gap_summary$estimate_pp
)

interval_label <- sprintf(
    "95%% bootstrap interval: %+.2f to %+.2f pp",
    gap_summary$ci_l_pp,
    gap_summary$ci_u_pp
)

# Describe whether the approximate interval includes zero.
includes_zero <- (
    gap_summary$ci_l_pp <= 0 &
    gap_summary$ci_u_pp >= 0
)

interpretation <- if (includes_zero) {
    "Approximate interval includes zero"
} else {
    "Approximate interval excludes zero"
}

# Leave breathing room around the interval and zero.
x_min <- min(0, gap_summary$ci_l_pp, gap_summary$estimate_pp) - 0.8
x_max <- max(0, gap_summary$ci_u_pp, gap_summary$estimate_pp) + 0.8

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Visualization
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

plot <- ggplot2::ggplot(gap_summary) +
    # Zero indicates equal AUROC between populations.
    ggplot2::geom_vline(
        xintercept = 0,
        linetype = "dashed",
        color = atg_palette[["burgundy"]],
        linewidth = 0.9
    ) +
    # Approximate 95% bootstrap confidence interval.
    ggplot2::geom_segment(
        ggplot2::aes(
            x = ci_l_pp,
            xend = ci_u_pp,
            y = 1,
            yend = 1
        ),
        color = atg_palette[["evergreen"]],
        linewidth = 1.6
    ) +
    # Left confidence interval cap.
    ggplot2::geom_segment(
        ggplot2::aes(
            x = ci_l_pp,
            xend = ci_l_pp,
            y = 0.96,
            yend = 1.04
        ),
        color = atg_palette[["evergreen"]],
        linewidth = 1.2
    ) +
    # Right confidence interval cap.
    ggplot2::geom_segment(
        ggplot2::aes(
            x = ci_u_pp,
            xend = ci_u_pp,
            y = 0.96,
            yend = 1.04
        ),
        color = atg_palette[["evergreen"]],
        linewidth = 1.2
    ) +
    # Observed AUROC difference.
    ggplot2::geom_point(
        ggplot2::aes(
            x = estimate_pp,
            y = 1
        ),
        color = atg_palette[["evergreen"]],
        size = 4.5
    ) +
    # Display the estimate directly above the point.
    ggplot2::geom_text(
        ggplot2::aes(
            x = estimate_pp,
            y = 1.15,
            label = estimate_label
        ),
        color = atg_palette[["evergreen"]],
        fontface = "bold",
        size = 4.5
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(
        labels = function(values) {
            sprintf("%+.1f pp", values)
        },
        breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 6)
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(
        breaks = 1,
        labels = "2025 logistic model",
        limits = c(0.78, 1.35)
    ) +
    ggplot2::coord_cartesian(
        xlim = c(x_min, x_max),
        clip = "off"
    ) +
    atg_theme() +
    ggplot2::theme(
        panel.grid.major.y = ggplot2::element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank(),
        axis.title.y = ggplot2::element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_text(
            face = "bold",
            size = 11
        ),
        plot.caption = ggplot2::element_text(
            size = 8,
            hjust = 0,
            margin = ggplot2::margin(t = 14)
        )
    ) +
    ggplot2::labs(
        title = "Does model discrimination differ for AI/AN adults?",
        subtitle = paste(
            "2025 survey-weighted AUROC difference |",
            selected$chosen_family,
            "\n",
            interval_label,
            "|",
            interpretation
        ),
        x = "AI/AN minus comparison AUROC (percentage points)",
        caption = paste(
            "Point = observed subgroup AUROC difference;",
            "whisker = approximate 95% PSU-bootstrap percentile interval.",
            "\nNegative values indicate lower AI/AN discrimination.",
            "Dashed line indicates no difference.",
            "\nFixed predictions; within-stratum PSU resampling.",
            "Exploratory approximation, not CDC replicate weights."
        )
    )

# Save under a distinct filename to preserve the histogram.
show_and_save(
    plot,
    "12_2025_auc_gap_interval",
    11,
    4.5
)

print(gap_summary)

```
Note: The interval includes zero, so the observed difference is not conclusive under this bootstrap approximation.
